question: What luminous reality is being referred to as previously described to the Goddess?
premises: A mass of radiance is named.
It is identified as something already spoken.
inference: The teaching refers back to a previously described mass of radiance.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of tejaḥ+puñjaṃ as object or topic is compressed in this verse.
plain_english: O great Goddess, O lotus-faced one, that mass of radiance which was spoken of.
